title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build, train, and deploy advanced artificial intelligence algorithms, neural networks, and NLP systems. Utilize PyTorch, TensorFlow, vector databases, and MLOps tools to bring AI solutions to life.
recommended_degrees: BS Computer Science (AI & Machine Learning Track)
top_recommended_universities: Mapúa University (ABET Accredited & CHED COE in CS / IT)
UP Diliman (UPD - CHED Center of Excellence in Computer Science)
De La Salle University (DLSU - THE/QS Ranked in CS)
MSU-IIT (CHED Center of Excellence in IT)
Ateneo de Manila University (ADMU - Department of Information Systems)
side_project_blueprints: Build a RAG AI Question-Answering Agent using Vector Databases and PyTorch
Train a Custom Computer Vision Model for Real-Time Object Detection
Develop an MLOps Pipeline for Automated Model Training and Cloud Deployment

stage_advice.freshman: Master Linear Algebra, Multivariable Calculus, and Python fundamentals during 1st year.
stage_advice.student: Focus on Neural Networks, Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision electives.
stage_advice.job_seeker: Publish a machine learning side project on GitHub or Kaggle highlighting LLM fine-tuning and RAG.
stage_advice.career_shifter: Enroll in MS Artificial Intelligence (MS AI) or complete Andrew Ng's Deep Learning Specialization.

key_responsibilities: Train large language models (LLMs) and neural networks on specialized datasets
Build RAG pipelines and vector similarity indexing for intelligent agents
Deploy models to cloud endpoints with Docker and Kubernetes

career_roadmap.focus: Data preprocessing, model training, API wrapping.
Custom neural architecture design, fine-tuning, RAG optimization.
Generative AI roadmap, foundation model research, enterprise integration.

title: Data Scientist
description: Extract valuable business intelligence and actionable insights from structured and unstructured data using Python, R, machine learning, and statistical analytics. Build predictive models and data dashboards.

Mapúa University (BS Data Science & BS BIA)
De La Salle University (DLSU - Data Science)
Ateneo de Manila University (ADMU - Math/CS)
Silliman University (CHED COE in IT)
side_project_blueprints: Analyze Customer Churn with Predictive Classification & Power BI Dashboards
Build a Real-Time Stock Market Forecasting Tool in Python
Develop an NLP Sentiment Analyzer for Philippine E-Commerce Reviews

stage_advice.freshman: Strengthen your knowledge in Probability & Statistics, Excel, and SQL during 1st year.
stage_advice.student: Focus on Pandas, Scikit-Learn, data visualization, and exploratory data analysis.

key_responsibilities: Develop predictive machine learning models and regression pipelines
Clean, explore, and analyze high-dimensional business data
Communicate data insights to stakeholders using clear visualizations

career_roadmap.focus: Data cleaning, SQL querying, and descriptive analytics dashboards.
Feature engineering, ML modeling, hypothesis testing, and model deployment.
Design enterprise AI strategy, MLOps infrastructure, and deep learning models.

title: Medical Doctor / Physician
description: Examine patients, diagnose medical conditions, prescribe medication, perform clinical treatments, and provide life-saving healthcare in hospitals and clinics across the Philippines.
top_recommended_universities: UP Manila (UPM - College of Medicine - #1 THE/QS Med in PH)
UST (Faculty of Medicine & Surgery - CHED Center of Excellence)
Ateneo School of Medicine & Public Health (ASMPH)
Mapúa School of Health Sciences (BS Health Sciences / Biology)
De La Salle Medical and Health Sciences Institute (DLSMHSI)
Saint Louis University (SLU Baguio - High PLE Board Passing Rate)
side_project_blueprints: Conduct Clinical Public Health Research on Community Disease Prevention
Publish a Medical Case Study Review in an Accredited Medical Journal
Volunteer in Telemedicine & Rural Health Outreach Programs
certifications_and_licenses: Physician Licensure Examination (PLE - PRC Medical Board Exam)
Basic Life Support (BLS) & Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS)

stage_advice.freshman: Maintain a high GPA in your Pre-Med bachelor degree (Biology, Health Sciences, Nursing, MedTech).
stage_advice.student: Prepare early for the National Medical Admission Test (NMAT) targeting 90+ percentile for top medical schools.
stage_advice.job_seeker: Complete 1-year Post-Graduate Internship (PGI) at top hospitals and pass the Physician Licensure Examination.
stage_advice.career_shifter: Complete required Pre-Med science prerequisites and sit for the NMAT exam.

key_responsibilities: Diagnose acute and chronic illnesses through physical examination and lab tests
Formulate patient treatment plans and prescribe medications
Perform emergency procedures and collaborate with specialist consultants

career_roadmap.focus: Complete Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree and PGI hospital internship.
Complete medical residency specialization (Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, Surgery).
Private practice, hospital leadership, and clinical research.
